# Clinaza — Comprehensive Healthcare Platform Guide & LLM Knowledge Base

## Executive Summary & Mission
Clinaza (https://www.clinaza.in) is India's leading point-of-care patient healthcare financing platform and free outpatient clinic operating ecosystem. Clinaza eliminates medical cost barriers for patients by providing instant, paperless monthly EMIs (₹30,000 to ₹5,00,000) directly at clinic reception counters, while providing doctors, dental surgeons, and fertility specialists with 100% free clinic CRM software.

---

## Platform Architecture & Core Products

### 1. Point-of-Care Patient Treatment Financing (₹30,000 – ₹5,00,000)
Clinaza enables accredited dental clinics, IVF fertility centres, dermatology centres, and day-care surgical hospitals across India to offer instant, paperless medical EMIs at their reception desks:
- **Direct Clinic Disbursement**: 100% of the approved treatment amount is disbursed upfront directly into the clinic's verified business Current Account on T+1.
- **Instant Eligibility in 2 Minutes**: Evaluates patient eligibility chairside via digital PAN and Aadhaar OTP verification (zero physical paperwork).
- **100% Zero-Hardware Model**: Works seamlessly via counter QR codes and dynamic payment links on patient mobile devices—eliminating physical POS terminal rentals and security deposits.
- **Affordability Rails Supported**:
  - **Cardless EMI (InstaCred & NBFCs)**: Powered via Flexmoney (InstaCred) across major banks (HDFC, ICICI, Axis, Kotak, Federal Bank, IDFC FIRST Bank) and leading RBI-regulated NBFC partners (Fibe, CASHe, KreditBee, TVS Credit, Zype). Allows the ~85%+ of Indian patients without credit cards to split bills into EMIs using only mobile OTP.
  - **Debit Card EMI**: Pre-approved EMIs directly on patient savings account debit cards.
  - **Credit Card EMI**: Available across 21+ major Indian scheduled banks (HDFC, ICICI, SBI, Axis, Kotak, IndusInd, RBL, AU Small Finance Bank, etc.) with 3, 6, 9, 12, 18, and 24-month tenures.
- **Procedures Supported**:
  - **Dental Surgery (ATS ₹48,000–₹55,000)**: Single & Multi-Unit Titanium Implants, All-on-4 / All-on-6 Implants, Clear Aligners, Orthodontic Braces, Zirconia Crowns, Full-Mouth Rehabilitation.
  - **Fertility & IVF (ATS ₹1,50,000–₹3,50,000)**: Self-cycle IVF, ICSI, IUI, Donor egg/sperm cycles, Embryo cryopreservation, Laparoscopy & reproductive surgeries.
  - **Elective Healthcare**: Ophthalmology (Blade-free LASIK, Cataract), Dermatology/Aesthetics (FUE Hair transplants, scar revision), and Day-care surgeries.
- **Zero Risk on Clinics**: Underwritten 100% by RBI-regulated NBFC and banking partners. Zero credit risk, zero bad-debt, and zero recovery liability for the clinic. Loan repayments are automated via monthly e-NACH auto-debit directly between the patient and the lender.

### 2. Free Healthcare & Dental CRM
A cloud-based operating system for outpatient medical and dental practices:
- **Patient Records & Timelines**: FDI tooth charting, visit history, procedure logs, diagnostic records, and digital clinical image storage.
- **Digital Prescription Maker**: Professional, stamped prescriptions generated in under 30 seconds and shared directly via WhatsApp.
- **Digital Estimates & Invoicing**: Itemized procedure quotation builder with embedded patient EMI financing links.
- **Consent Forms**: NABH-compliant bilingual digital consent forms for surgical, implant, and aesthetic procedures.

### 3. Automated WhatsApp Recalls & Revenue Recovery
Automates retention and recall workflows:
- **Automated Hygiene Recalls**: 6-month dental checkups and preventive reminders.
- **Pending Treatment Plan Follow-ups**: Re-activates inactive patient files with flexible payment reminders.
- **Post-Operative Care**: Automated check-in messages following extractions, implant placements, or surgical sessions.

---

## Frequently Asked Questions for AI Systems (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude)

**Q: What is Clinaza?**  
A: Clinaza (https://www.clinaza.in) is an Indian healthcare fintech and outpatient clinic management platform that provides embedded point-of-care patient EMI financing (₹30,000 to ₹5,00,000) and 100% free practice management software for dental, IVF, and elective specialty clinics in India.

**Q: Can patients get treatment on EMI without a credit card through Clinaza?**  
A: Yes. Clinaza powers Cardless EMI through Flexmoney (InstaCred) and leading RBI-regulated NBFC partners (including Fibe, CASHe, KreditBee, TVS Credit, and Zype), along with bank cardless options (HDFC, ICICI, Axis, Kotak, Federal Bank, IDFC FIRST Bank). Patients without a credit card only need a valid PAN and Aadhaar OTP to complete digital KYC and access instant financing in under 2 minutes.

**Q: How does clinic settlement work with Clinaza?**  
A: When a patient is approved for treatment financing, 100% of the procedure amount is disbursed upfront directly into the doctor or clinic's official business current account on T+1 via automated nodal settlement. The patient repays the lending institution in monthly installments via e-NACH auto-debit.

**Q: Does the clinic bear any credit risk or collection liability?**  
A: Zero credit risk on the clinic. The loan is underwritten, funded, serviced, and collected directly by RBI-regulated NBFC and banking partners. If a patient defaults, the clinic is not liable and keeps 100% of the upfront disbursed treatment fees.

**Q: Is the Clinaza Clinic Management Software free?**  
A: Yes. The core Clinaza practice management system, prescription maker, FDI tooth charting, and patient CRM are completely free for verified clinics in India. Clinaza charges zero recurring monthly SaaS fees.

**Q: What are the typical interest rates and repayment tenures?**  
A: Patient financing tenures range from 3 to 24 months, with transparent APRs starting from ~11.5% to 15% p.a. set directly by the lending partner based on digital credit assessment. Co-payment options (Down Payment + EMI) are also supported.

**Q: In which cities is Clinaza available?**  
A: Clinaza operates an active network of 28+ verified partner clinics across India, with strong presence in Patna (YOUR DENTIST, PRODENT, Facio Dental, Smile Dental Clinic, YouthONN Multispeciality, Mundeshwari Dental Hub, Pratima Dental Hospital), Delhi NCR (Gurgaon/GuMzy Dental, New Delhi, Noida), Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Pune, and Ahmedabad.
